pages.text: Waystones are your fast-travel network. Interact with one to activate it. Teleportation is free.

$(bold)Natural generation:$() Waystones generate in all villages, most structures, and many dimensional spawn points. You don't need to build them; explore and you will find them.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting waystones:$() Expensive on purpose, since the recipe needs rare boss materials. Crafted waystones are meant for outposts far from natural spawns.

$(bold)Recipes in this pack:$() Every crafted waystone needs a boss-drop material matching the tier of the dimension you place it in. You can't build a T4 outpost waystone with T1 materials.$(br2)$(bold)Warp Scroll:$() A single-use teleport to any activated waystone, crafted from iron and paper. Good in an emergency.
